findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:0 verificationIntent explicitly promises that missing/stale/contradictory host probe evidence invalidates fallback records for BOTH eligibility=single-host-environment AND eligibility=temporary-host-unavailability. Implementation (reviewHostAvailabilityProbeRequiredForEligibility in packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:548-550) does gate both values identically, but no verificationEvidence actually exercises eligibility=temporary-host-unavailability anywhere: grep for the literal string across packages/main/src/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.ts, packages/main/src/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.ts, and tests/ finds zero matches (it only appears in production source: review-escalation.ts, command-policy.ts, command-schemas.ts). The recorded CHK-002:adversarial:0 evidence note itself only claims single-host-environment coverage ("reject single-host-environment fallback when a fresh probe shows two or more executable canonical hosts"), which is narrower than the intent text it is meant to satisfy. Add a smoke check that constructs a review_escalation_fallback record with eligibility=temporary-host-unavailability and asserts it is rejected under missing/stale probe evidence the same way single-host-environment is, in both evaluateReviewEscalation and evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor.
